Entity.name: Attribute transformation
Entity.comment: *An attribute transformation transforms 1-many source attributes into one attribute value. Transformations from external systems to the consolidated model fill an attribute and use at least 1 system attribute. Transformations from the model to external systems fill a system attribute and use at least 1 attribute.
Entity.notes: [DE_ENTI_COMMENT[ Eine Attributtransformation transformiert 1-viele Ausgangsattribute in einen Attributwert. Transformationen von externen Systemen zum konsolidierten Modell befüllen ein Attribut und verwenden min. 1 Systemattribut. Transformationen vom Modell zu externen Systemen befüllen ein Systemattribut und verwenden min. 1 Attribut. ]DE_ENTI_COMMENT] [EN_ENTI_COMMENT[ *An attribute transformation transforms 1-many source attributes into one attribute value. Transformations from external systems to the consolidated model fill an attribute and use at least 1 system attribute. Transformations from the model to external systems fill a system attribute and use at least 1 attribute. ]EN_ENTI_COMMENT]
